mike_runtime: Heads-up: saw KV fragmentation climb during a 2h canary — looks correlated with longchat sessions + per-request prefix salts. Dumping notes.

tara_ops: logs?

mike_runtime: pasted profile snippet: KV residency jumped from 6% -> 19% in 2h, pagefaults + GC spikes. suspect many distinct prefix keys from per-request salt.

anika_ml: Are salts per-tenant? We added request-id suffix in key derivation last month.

dan_prodeng: We did — rationale was to avoid cross-tenant collision for multitenant models. But it increases cardinality.

mike_runtime: Proposal: split key into (stable-prefix, ephemeral-tag). Use stable-prefix for KV lookup and attach ephemeral metadata separately. That keeps reuse and still isolates tenants.

tara_ops: Example?

mike_runtime: ```
# old: kv_key = f"{tenant}:{model}:{prefix}:{req_id}"
# new:
stable = f"{tenant}:{model}:{prefix}"
ephemeral = req_id  # not part of eviction key
kv_lookup_key = sha1(stable).hexdigest()  # short fingerprint
store_meta(ephemeral -> request_meta)  # side-store
```

anika_ml: :thumbsup: Might help reuse. Concern: leaking tenant info into shared cache? stable still has tenant but fingerprinting masks it.

kv-bot: perf: ran synthetic with 10k tenants -> reuse went 12% -> 48%, memory residency down 30%, tail latency -18ms

dan_prodeng: Nice. What about eviction semantics? If ephemeral not in key, could we get staleness where prefix matches but different req requires different KV cache state?

mike_runtime: We only cache unambiguous KV segments (prefix embeddings, transformer KV). For per-request session state we keep session-local overlay that composes on top. If overlay misses, runtime recomputes small partial KV.

tara_ops: Need to update compaction sweep to treat fingerprint keys as atomic — don't evict partial waiter pages.

anika_ml: Also need deterministic hash to avoid cross-machine divergence. Use siphash64 with tenant-specific seed.

mike_runtime: Ran a canary patch: siphash64(seed=tenant_salt) -> canonicalized keys. Results: fragmentation metric 'slot-entropy' dropped from 0.78 -> 0.42. Longctx mem growth slowed.

dan_prodeng: Can we break down regressions? Any perf regressions from hashing overhead?

mike_runtime: CPU overhead ~0.6% at p95, but token throughput unchanged. Net saving > memory + fewer page faults.

tara_ops: Plan: roll to canary 10% traffic, collect kv_hit_rate, page_faults, tail_latency, mem_residency. I'll add dashboards.

mike_runtime: Also note observed 'tombstone' accumulation when evicting fingerprinted keys. Need background sweep to compact tombstones every 10k evictions.

anika_ml: Sounds good. I'll write eval harness to ensure quality unchanged (sample prompts).

mike_runtime: Thanks. If no objections we'll open PR with key split + siphash. Dan, can you validate security review for fingerprinting masked tenant ids?

dan_prodeng: On it. ETA EOD.

kv-bot: :white_check_mark: scheduled canary for next deploy window.
